body:
⚡ CyberSandevistan – Advanced Cyber-Implant System for Purpur/Paper 1.21.1
📋 Overview
CyberSandevistan is a premium-quality Minecraft plugin that brings the iconic cyber-implant from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners to your Purpur/Paper 1.21.1 server. This fully customizable system adds a wearable Netherite helmet that grants players superhuman abilities with stunning visual effects.

Transform your server into a cyberpunk battlefield with three distinct combat modes, each featuring unique particles, stat boosts, and gameplay mechanics. Perfect for RPG servers, PvP arenas, or as exclusive VIP perks.

✨ Key Features
⚙️ Three Unique Combat Modes
Mode	Effects	Particles
⚡ Fast Mode	6x movement speed	Blue particles
⚔️ Combat Mode	2x damage + 40% resistance	Red particles
👁️ Stealth Mode	Invisibility + 1.5x damage	Black particles
🎮 Interactive GUI Menu
Right-click the helmet to open a stylish mode selection menu

Visual feedback for mode selection

Fully customizable via config.yml

🛡️ Permission System
Granular access control for VIP/Premium/Admin groups

Easy integration with LuckPerms

Configurable permission nodes

🎨 Visual Effects
RGB particle system with HEX color support

3-layer particle spawn pattern

Smooth animations

Activation/deactivation sound effects

⏱️ Balanced Gameplay
Independent cooldown per mode

Configurable duration settings

Auto-deactivation after time expires

Damage multiplier tracking

🔧 Fully Configurable
All values adjustable in config.yml

Custom messages and GUI titles

Per-mode stats and durations

Particle colors in HEX format

📊 Default Settings
Mode	Duration	Cooldown	Speed	Damage	Resistance	Invisibility
⚡ Fast	8 sec	25 sec	6.0x	1.0x	0%	No
⚔️ Combat	10 sec	35 sec	2.0x	2.0x	40%	No
👁️ Stealth	6 sec	40 sec	3.0x	1.5x	0%	Yes
🎮 Commands
Command	Description	Permission
/sandevistan get	Get the cyber implant	sandevistan.admin
/sandevistan menu	Open GUI menu	sandevistan.use
/sandevistan reload	Reload config	sandevistan.admin
🔑 Permissions
Permission	Description	Default
sandevistan.use	Basic usage	false
sandevistan.vip	VIP access	false
sandevistan.premium	Premium access	false
sandevistan.admin	Admin commands	op
📦 Installation
Place CyberSandevistan.jar in /plugins folder

Restart your server

Configure permissions via LuckPerms

Run /sandevistan get to obtain the implant

Equip the helmet and right-click to open menu

Select mode and press SHIFT to activate!

⚙️ Technical Requirements
Java 21 (required)

Purpur/Paper 1.21.1 server software

LuckPerms (recommended)

Vault (optional for future economy features)

🎯 Perfect For
✅ VIP Perks – Exclusive donor features

✅ RP Servers – Cyberpunk-themed roleplay

✅ PvP Arenas – Strategic combat choices

✅ Minigames – Speed/stealth challenges

✅ Faction Servers – Unique player abilities
